data.name: NIGHTSWEEPER
data.detailed_description:
NIGHTSWEEPER follows Melani, a young Sweeper traveling through the Low Waste, a white desert beneath a bleak sun. Its abandoned roads pass ruined settlements and fields where broken golems were discarded.

She travels beyond the wall to recover ancient artifacts, then brings them back to work through the magic trapped inside.

Magic keeps traces of the people who shaped it. In grimoires, artifacts, and talismans, those traces can settle into scars. Each find becomes a sequence of puzzle pages. Read numbered clues, reveal safe tiles, and mark hidden scars without breaking the spell around them.

Once an artifact is clean, sell it and buy tools and upgrades to improve Melani's abilities. Navigate and search deeper into the desert, then return with more artifacts to sweep.

SWEEP CAREFULLY

The pages use the familiar logic of Minesweeper: each numbered tile helps reveal where scars are hidden nearby. Clear safe spaces and mark every scar to finish the page. One wrong choice can break the spell.

The artifact holding the spell and the person who shaped it can bend those rules, changing the board's shape, obscuring clues, or altering how scars are counted.

BRING WHAT YOU NEED

Manage items and choose what to carry with you. Build an inventory of tools and magical apparel that can reveal information, alter pages, or help with difficult patterns. Different loadouts offer different ways to approach an artifact, while new purchases and upgrades expand what Melani can do.

BEYOND THE WALL

Story Mode moves between first-person exploration and spell-sweeping. Search abandoned settlements, cross the golem fields, read the desert for traps, and recover artifacts to bring back beyond the wall. Story Mode is expected to take around 6-8 hours to complete.

Sell spells and artifacts that Melani restores, and gradually search farther from safety. Her story unfolds along the lost roads, leading toward the darkest part of the desert.

KEEP SWEEPING

Endless Mode removes the exploration entirely. Sweep one spell after another until failure ends the run.

  • 6-8 Hour Story Mode and Endless Mode

  • First-Person Desert Exploration

  • Minesweeper-Inspired Spell-Sweeping

  • Progression Through Artifacts, Inventory, Tools, and Ability Upgrades

  • Ambient and Suspenseful Original Soundtrack

  • A Mystery in the Darkest Part of the Desert

data.short_description: NIGHTSWEEPER is a 3D puzzle adventure about recovering ancient artifacts from an abandoned white desert, sweeping the scars from their spells with Minesweeper-inspired puzzles, and selling them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance: 1080p/30 FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690K / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance: 1080p/60 FPS.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (64-bit)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable Apple, Intel, or AMD GPU
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance: 1080p/30 FPS. Universal build for Apple silicon and Intel.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro or Intel Core i7 (64-bit)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro GPU / AMD Radeon Pro 5500M or better
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance: 1080p/60 FPS.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or SteamOS (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (Vulkan or OpenGL 3.2+)
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance: 1080p/30 FPS. X11 or Wayland.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 or SteamOS (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690K / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 (Vulkan)
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance: 1080p/60 FPS.
